name: vicky-skills
description: Approved Given / When / Then examples as the spec a build must pass, and a guard on approved tests

guard_pr.title: One open pull request per effort
guard_pr.description: Refuse a second pull request from one session, a stack nobody asked for, and AI credit in pull request text. A ticket filed before the session started counts as a separate effort.

guard_pr_ignore_heads.title: Branches the pull request guard ignores
guard_pr_ignore_heads.description: Space-separated branch prefixes whose pull requests never count, such as bot branches.

guard_issue_threads.title: Read whole threads
guard_issue_threads.description: Refuse an issue or pull request view that leaves out its comments.

tea_stdin.title: Close tea's stdin
tea_stdin.description: Refuse a tea command that leaves stdin open, since tea blocks on it and a retry can post twice.

guard_local_paths.title: No local paths in commits
guard_local_paths.description: Refuse a commit that adds your home folder, username or another machine-specific path.

local_path_exempt_repos.title: Repos allowed to hold local paths
local_path_exempt_repos.description: Space-separated owner/repo names the local-path guard skips, such as a dotfiles repo.

guard_push_behind.title: No push from behind main
guard_push_behind.description: Refuse a push from a branch that lacks the tip of origin's default branch.
